AND 
 
2 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to at least one prior therapy (including 
skin-directed therapies [e.g., corticosteroids (clobetasol, diflorasone, halobetasol, augmented 
betamethasone dipropionate), phototherapy, or systemic therapies [e.g. Interferons])

Consensus of 1, 2A, or 2B.
